diagram_previews.alt: Three squares sharing the bottom-left corner A, nested inside each other, with their bottom sides along one line; B, C and D are the bottom-right corners of the small, middle and large squares.

Three squares with sides 4, 7 and 10 sharing the bottom-left corner A, with B, C, D along the bottom side. The part of the middle square outside the smallest square is shaded blue and labelled b^2 - a^2 = 33; the top sides of the squares are labelled a, b and c, and arrows below the base mark BC = b - a and CD = c - b.
